design_tokens.findings: Computed primary button background rgb(37, 99, 235) matches design token #2563EB on products and adjustments pages; border-radius 4px matches rounded-sm; table cell typography 12px/text-gray-500 consistent with docs/DESIGN.canvas.tsx. Summary page toolbar has no primary button (expected).

accessibility.findings: axe-core runs: independent review caught 6 in-scope color-contrast nodes (text-green-600/red-600 table spans on summary) which were fixed to 700-shade tokens and confirmed by post-fix re-run. Remaining findings are pre-existing shared app chrome (icon-only Header search/bell buttons without names, slate-500-on-slate-900 sidebar headers at 3.75:1, duplicate nav landmarks) present identically on every app page. One accepted-convention minor: empty actions-column header per finance/payables.tsx convention; row buttons are self-labeled. All in-table controls keyboard reachable with visible focus rings (focus-hover-states journey).

responsive_layout.findings: At 390px the filter select expands to full width (w-full sm:w-44), tables scroll horizontally without clipping page chrome, PageTabs remain usable, and no horizontal overflow of container content was observed in mobile screenshots. Modal fits mobile viewport.

visual_consistency.findings: All three inventory pages share PageTabs + PageContainer header pattern, identical Table styling, badge color language (green/gray for Active/Inactive; stock status colors single-sourced from stockStatus()), and consistent button variants.

component_quality.findings: Reusable Table/Badge/Modal/Input/Select/Pagination components used without duplication; loading skeleton, empty message, and error banner states wired; pagination hidden when rows (10) < PAGE_SIZE (20) which is correct conditional behavior confirmed at all viewports.

analysis.notes: Score is desktop/tablet/mobile screenshot review + computed-style token probes + axe output. Pre-existing app-chrome accessibility debt tracked separately from this increment.
